atomic_write.strategy: temp file (.bridge-tmp-*.part) + flush + fsync + os.replace (same filesystem) + mode preserve + tmp cleanup on failure
atomic_write.verify: post-write read-back byte match; cache invalidate; journal record with pre-image backup

checkpoints.mechanism: git_checkpoint + checkpoints.py + session journal with per-write backups
checkpoints.resume: session reopen replays journal; SSE Last-Event-ID recovery; revision/rollback routes

crash_recovery.result: committed steps valid; s3.txt verifiably absent; no plan_complete record; no fabricated completion

partial_writes.behavior: refused writes leave original intact (sandbox/admin gates precede mutation); failed atomic writes remove temp and raise

concurrent_writes.same_file: atomic replace => winner whole, never torn (tested); cross-task same-file ordering via ResourceScheduler write-collision guard (waves)
concurrent_writes.note: last-writer-wins for racy same-file writes is explicit and documented, not silent corruption

conflicts.approvals: pending_approvals + gates; tested in events/approval suites

rollback.status: supported (journal pre-images + git checkpoints + session rollback routes)

limitations: same-file concurrent races resolve last-writer-wins (use scheduler guard for determinism)
crash-during-fsync window relies on OS/filesystem durability
